messages.message: ### Step 2: Morphosyntactic Requirement Definition Goal: For Malayalam, specify per-token morphosyntax needed to realize the Step 1 Interpretation Lock. Output: ONE Markdown table only (no prose). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Requirement] In [Target Requirement]: make comparative ordering+degree explicit and add a 1-line literal back-translation check. Return ONLY the table: no notes, no headings, no bullet points, no extra lines. Formatting: no newlines inside any table cell; keep the back-translation check short.

Nel | preposition + definite article “in the” | case=locative; noun = മധ്യം+loc‑suffix ‑യിൽ; BT: in the middle mezzo | noun “middle” (spatial centre) | noun stem = മധ്യം; degree=neutral; BT: middle del | preposition + definite article “of the” | genitive case marker ‑യുടെ attached to following noun; BT: of the cammin | noun “road” (archaic) | noun stem = വഴി; case=genitive ‑യുടെ; BT: road of di | preposition “of” (genitive) | genitive case marker ‑യുടെ on noun; BT: of nostra | possessive adjective “our” (collective) | possessive pronoun ‑യുടെ attached to noun; BT: our vita | noun “life” | noun stem = ജീവിതം; case=genitive ‑യുടെ; BT: life mi | clitic reflexive pronoun “myself” | reflexive pronoun = എന്നെ; positioned as object of verb; BT: myself ritrovai | verb “found (myself)” 1st sg remote past | verb stem = കണ്ടെത്തി; tense=remote past; mood=indicative; BT: I found per | preposition “within” | locative case marker ‑യിൽ on following noun; BT: within una | indefinite article “a” (fem) | indefinite determiner expressed by noun without article; BT: a selva | noun “forest/wood” | noun stem = കാട്; case=locative ‑യിൽ; BT: forest oscura | adjective “dark” | adjective stem = ഇരുണ്ട; agreement with noun (fem, singular); BT: dark ché | causal conjunction “for” | conjunction = കാരണം; links clause; BT: for la | definite article “the” (fem) | definite noun without article; context‑determined; BT: the diritta | adjective “right” (correct) | adjective stem = ശരിയായ; agreement with noun (fem, singular); BT: right via | noun “way” | noun stem = വഴി; case=nominative; BT: way era | verb “was” 3rd sg imperfect | verb stem = ഇരുന്നു; tense=imperfect; BT: was smarrita | past participle “missed/lost” | adjective stem = കാണാതായ; agreement with noun (fem, singular); BT: missed

### Step 3: Lexical Inventory & Syntactic Assembly Task: For each source line, list ALL required lexical items from Step 2, then assemble into Malayalam. Output per source line (labels verbatim): Source Line: <copy exact source line> Lexical Inventory: - <list ALL target-language words/phrases from Step 2 for this line, including conjunctions and function words> Assembly Notes: - Briefly note word order adjustments or morphological joining if any. Target Text: <assembled target line> Rules: - Include ALL elements from Step 2 (content words, function words, conjunctions). Missing elements cause coverage failures. - No new content words beyond Step 2 inventory. - Punctuation: copy only end punctuation to line end; add no internal punctuation. - Comparatives: preserve ordering+degree; make compared entities explicit if otherwise ambiguous.

Source Line: Nel mezzo del cammin di nostra vita Lexical Inventory: - Nel → യിൽ - mezzo → മധ്യം - del → യുടെ - cammin → വഴി - di → യുടെ - nostra → ഞങ്ങളുടെ - vita → ജീവിതം Assembly Notes: - “Nel” supplies the locative suffix “‑യിൽ” which attaches to “മധ്യം” forming “മധ്യത്തിൽ”. - “del” adds the genitive suffix “‑യുടെ” to “വഴി” → “വഴിയുടെ”. - “di” adds another genitive “‑യുടെ” to “ജീവിതം” → “ജീവിതത്തിന്റെ”. - Possessor phrase “ഞങ്ങളുടെ ജീവിതത്തിന്റെ” precedes the noun “വഴി”. - Final order follows Malayalam noun‑possessor‑genitive pattern, then the locative phrase. Target Text: ഞങ്ങളുടെ ജീവിതത്തിന്റെ വഴിയുടെ മധ്യത്തിൽ
Source Line: mi ritrovai per una selva oscura, Lexical Inventory: - mi → എന്നെ - ritrovai → കണ്ടെത്തി - per → യിൽ - una → ഒരു - selva → കാട് - oscura → ഇരുണ്ട Assembly Notes: - Reflexive pronoun “എന്നെ” is the object of “കണ്ടെത്തി”. - “per” provides the locative suffix “‑യിൽ” attached to “കാട്” → “കാടിൽ”. - Indefinite article “una” rendered as “ഒരു” placed before the adjective‑noun pair. - Adjective “ഇരുണ്ട” precedes the noun “കാട്”. - Order: pronoun + verb + indefinite + adjective + noun + locative. Target Text: എന്നെ കണ്ടെത്തി ഒരു ഇരുണ്ട കാടിൽ
Source Line: ché la diritta via era smarrita. Lexical Inventory: - ché → കാരണം - la → ആ - diritta → ശരിയായ - via → വഴി - era → ഇരുന്നു - smarrita → കാണാതായ Assembly Notes: - Causal conjunction “കാരണം” introduces the clause. - Definite article “la” rendered as “ആ” before the noun phrase. - Copular verb “ഇരുന്നു” combines with past participle “കാണാതായ” to form “കാണാതായിരുന്നു”. - Order: conjunction + definite article + adjective + noun + predicate adjective with copula. Target Text: കാരണം ആ ശരിയായ വഴി കാണാതായിരുന്നു

### Step 4: Self-Correction via Back-Translation & Grammatical Check For each line: verify Step3 Target Text vs Reference Translation + Step1 Locked Meaning; correct within-line only. Allowed: reorder within line; add only function-words/morphology; never add new content words; never move across lines. Punctuation: keep only end punctuation from source; no internal punctuation. Meaning Drift includes wrong modifier attachment/scope. Output per line bullets with EXACT fields (no extras): Line #, Target Text, Back-Translation, Reference Translation, Checks, Corrected Target Text (if any). Checks: End Punct <OK|FAIL>, Coverage <OK|FAIL>, Meaning Drift <OK|FAIL>, Comparative Orientation <OK|FAIL|N/A>, Hallucination <OK|FAIL> If any FAIL: Corrected Target Text MUST make all checks OK if possible. Comparative Orientation: preserve ordering+degree; treat (A>B) ≡ (B<A) and (A<B) ≡ (B>A); FAIL only if ordering reversed or degree lost. After all lines: if any line still FAILs, output UNVERIFIED with failing Line #s; otherwise do not output UNVERIFIED. Output final Malayalam text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 1, ഞങ്ങളുടെ ജീവിതത്തിന്റെ വഴിയുടെ മധ്യത്തിൽ, in the middle of the road of our life, Midway upon the road of our life, End Punct <OK>; Coverage <OK>; Meaning Drift <OK>; Comparative Orientation <N/A>; Hallucination <OK>, None - Line 2, എന്നെ കണ്ടെത്തി ഒരു ഇരുണ്ട കാടിൽ, I found myself in a dark forest, I found myself within a dark wood, End Punct <FAIL>; Coverage <OK>; Meaning Drift <OK>; Comparative Orientation <N/A>; Hallucination <OK>, എന്നെ കണ്ടെത്തി ഒരു ഇരുണ്ട കാടിൽ, - Line 3, കാരണം ആ ശരിയായ വഴി കാണാതായിരുന്നു, because the right way was missed, for the right way had been missed, End Punct <OK>; Coverage <OK>; Meaning Drift <OK>; Comparative Orientation <N/A>; Hallucination <OK>, None
```malayalam ഞങ്ങളുടെ ജീവിതത്തിന്റെ വഴിയുടെ മധ്യത്തിൽ എന്നെ കണ്ടെത്തി ഒരു ഇരുണ്ട കാടിൽ, കാരണം ആ ശരിയായ വഴി കാണാതായിരുന്നു ```
